audience: sales and service teams that run Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities and Cases in SugarCRM

useCases.title: Count and list the opportunities closing this month
useCases.text: Count the Opportunities that match a Sugar filter, such as those closing this month. Then list the matches.

useCases.title: Find an account and read its contact details
useCases.text: Filter Accounts by name, then get one account by id to read its phone and website.

useCases.title: Review open cases for one assignee
useCases.text: Count the open Cases for one assignee with a filter, then list the matching records.

useCases.title: Update the sales stage of an opportunity
useCases.text: Read the allowed sales stage values, then update the stage of one Opportunity. Fields you leave out keep their values.

useCases.title: Create a lead from a new enquiry
useCases.text: Create one Lead with the field values you give. The new record is written to your Sugar data.
